name: Ninja War
summary: Ninja war - gather a team of the most powerful shinobi having unique techniques ninjutsu. Take part in ninja war and rescue the world of this Android game from total destruction. Collect cards with characters each having his strong and weak sides as well as unique skills. Try to gather an invincible team of shinobi where each member will make the other stronger. Combine skills of different ninja to make combo and crush enemies.
